title: TWENTY | Kimi Antonelli, youngest F1 world champion at 20 (ÆTHER) | a fan tribute
description:
One kid from Bologna. Formula 2 in 2024, a Mercedes seat at 18, the bad days, and then the title: youngest Formula 1 world champion in history, at 20 years and 68 days.

An original ÆTHER score, made as a fan tribute. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes-AMG F1 or Formula 1. Music made with AI tools.
